title: From Praying to Believing with Pastor Chris Zehner
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a life-changing discovery that transformed his prayer life and brought him closer to God. Learn how the words "thank you" can shift your prayers from asking to believing, and discover the profound impact it can have on your faith. Join Pastor Chris as he shares his personal testimony and teaches you how to pray with a newfound sense of faith and trust in God's goodness.
